flow cytometry assay.readouts: frequency and surface marker expression of monocytes, dendritic cells, and NK cell subsets

evidence.quote: PBMC samples were frozen in liquid nitrogen, thawed, stained, and acquired on an LSR Fortessa flow cytometer.
Samples were read in duplicates according to the manufacturer’s protocol on a Bio-Plex Luminex-200 (Bio-Rad) and analyzed using Bio-Plex Manager software.

evidence.section: EBOV-GP-Binding Antibody Responses Induced by the Vaccine
evidence.quote: GP-specific antibody responses were measured using an ELISA in two centralized laboratories (Marburg, Germany and United States Army Medical Research Institute for Infectious Diseases [USAMRIID], USA) on days 0, 7, 14, 28, 56, 84, and 180.

evidence.quote: Diluted libraries were multiplex-sequenced on the Illumina HiSeq 2500 instrument (single read, 50-bp run).
